name: unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T
rule: If any other Arc or Weak pointers to the same allocation as this exist, they must not be dereferenced or have active borrows for the duration of the mutable borrow returned by get_mut_unchecked.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::sync::Arc < T , A > { unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T }
